
• Tapping a message notification now opens that contact's chat, without an extra in-app pop-up on top.
• Share as a link: the invite link is shared as a proper link, so Messages and AirDrop can open it straight in Keyring. If a link arrives cut off, Keyring says so plainly instead of showing an error code. (Shorter links come once our link service is live.)
• If your agent no longer accepts this phone, Keyring now says so on the community's screen and in My Agent, with how to link again, instead of "your agent didn't answer".
• Keyring copes better when your agent's replies stop reaching the phone: it waits longer between retries, reopens a connection that has gone quiet, and its banner says "Your agent isn't answering this phone. Retrying."
• Community names in My Agent update after the community changes them.
• This build can receive app updates over the air, so some fixes can reach you without a new TestFlight build.
• Also includes everything in build 266.
